agent_priors_used: GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): path dependence / local-optimum capture - an agent's inherited next_question tends to re-select its own most recent subtask, so continuation must be re-justified against the whole portfolio rather than against local continuity.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): prerequisite centralization - a missing substrate prerequisite that repeatedly reappears as MEASUREMENT_INVALID across lanes should be repaired once in the lane that owns that substrate instead of being rediscovered per lane.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): benchmark dynamic range - a treatment cannot demonstrate an advantage when the strongest comparator is at ceiling, so non-degeneracy and behaviour differentiation must be certified before an expensive confirmatory run.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): capability floor before comparative benchmark - an under-capable consumer model produces a floor effect that can masquerade as a treatment effect, so the minimal capability test must pass before arm comparison.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): frozen-transaction integrity - once a design is frozen it should be completed as frozen rather than re-scoped; pre-freeze work is the correct place for strategic redirection.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): discovery-vs-persistence on the Web - site-native enumeration channels (robots/sitemap/search/feeds) can amortize structure discovery, so shortest-path depth is not automatically an unavoidable acquisition cost.

These argue against route replay and route imitation as the unit, but none landed an executable parameterized mechanism on the shipped product path. This allocation is the opposite of a replay rerun: it is the audited promotion of a parameterized mechanism with a known-positive round trip and a known-negative refusal. Not a duplicate.
allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be landed as a durable, promotable mechanism on the SHIPPED kernel path -- with a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate consisting of a known-positive executable inherited-parameterized-mechanism round trip plus a known-negative refusal with a recorded reason and a null action, tests, per-arm honest accounting, and kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the shipped treatment can actually demonstrate the executable inherited-parameterized mechanism, is qualified for the pinned Product promotion path, and closes blocker B1? The full four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark must NOT be run until the other two readiness conditions also hold.
allocation.rationale: The active mandate supersedes the parent handoff (which proposed running the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark / asymmetric-discovery fallback) and targets the global audit's rank-1 blocker B1: src/spider/kernel.py still ships only literal distill() at confidence 0.5 with no distill_parameterized(), so the audited richer carrier (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064: 12/15 held-out identifiers executed, 0/15 for the literal incumbent, known negatives refused) is not in the shipped product. Without a shipped executable treatment there can be no end-to-end economics measurement. The mandate's pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate (known positive + known negative + null action + honest per-arm accounting + kernel identity bound at freeze) is exactly the audited promotion evidence the architecture requires and cannot be bypassed by manual copying. Cognitive reset: if Product met today's Codex fresh, the single highest-leverage action is still to make the shipped kernel capable of an executable inherited-parameterized mechanism; the benchmark is downstream. Deferring the four-arm run respects the Director rule not to fund C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON execution until all three readiness conditions hold.

The cumulative global audit's central finding still governs: the factory has strong bounded positive pillars (parameterized mechanism induction/binding, a bounded intervention-valid substrate, a bounded freshness/extraction substrate, and a valid negative on value-level persistence on public HTTP) but has NOT proved the decisive external-agent chain observe->parameterized mechanism->executable shipped binding->lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task. That chain is gated by three readiness conditions, and each currently maps to one active unfinished transaction: B1 shipped executable carrier (Product EXP-PRODUCT-38063618592), B2 non-degenerate/contrastive task bank (Runtime EXP-RUNTIME-38063614732), B3 a same-model endpoint capable of the minimal multi-step Web task (Intel EXP-INTEL-38013769440). Two further transactions are unfinished central mechanism questions: Graph EXP-GRAPH-38046502943 (C-FRESHNESS D1V multi-anchor constructibility) and Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-38013774272 (C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY site-native discovery under design-contract v2); Physics EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 is FROZEN and must be executed to completion under its frozen design. DECISION: CONTINUE all six lanes on their active mandates. This is a reasoned call, not rubber-stamping: the active mandates already implement the global audit's stated priority order (Product B1; Runtime/Product B2; Intel B3; Graph freshness only if multi-anchor; Physics a materially new observable; Frontier site-native discovery), each is an unfinished transaction with a pre-declared go/no-go or certificate, and no genuinely higher-value unblocked alternative exists (C-CROSSSITE, C-PRODUCT-ECON and the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark are all DOWNSTREAM of B1/B2/B3 and must not be funded yet; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is right not to be reopened as an isolated micro-benchmark; C-DELTA-REPAIR needs a realistic distributed substrate that is not currently on the critical path). The tunnel flags on graph/physics/runtime are diagnostic only; after an explicit cognitive reset the active directions still win on merits. No lane is parked or terminated. No expensive full-benchmark execution is authorized this cycle.
